benchmarks.name: scene.delta

negative_control.detail: all exactness checks equal; scatter with one record omitted: 1 slot(s) differ, slot 688096 == omitted 688096; direct with frame n-2 re-application skipped: 10278 slot(s) differ, expected 10278 (identical sets);

benchmarks.notes: Part 2 uses distinct slots from an odd stride (no shuffle) so CPU work per frame stays far below GPU time; part 1 uses a random partial Fisher-Yates order.
benchmarks.title: Delta updates of a persistent GPU scene: scatter vs direct shared copies vs full, cross-frame wait

benchmarks.name: scene.draws

negative_control.detail: all variants bit-identical (image + drawn[]) at every B, cull stand-in exact, built-in control (a_zero with the biggest bucket dropped) detected at every B

benchmarks.notes: cross-command-buffer behaviour without validation: v1..v4 all draw exactly (a_zero and a_compact); a10 ran: render_command::set_cull_mode / set_front_facing_winding compile and give the same image with an ICB created with inheritCullMode = inheritFrontFacingWinding = false; ICB is Private; encode_ms = encode dispatch alone, reset_ms = resetCommandsInBuffer on the GPU timeline; render_ms = span - empty pass; the ICB / args are produced in an earlier command buffer before the timed render pass
benchmarks.title: Draw emission: GPU-encoded ICB (ranges per cull class) vs indirect draw per bucket vs direct draws

benchmarks.name: scene.cull

negative_control.detail: left plane flipped -> 40764 slots differ from the CPU reference outside the band (must be > 339); determinism comparison detects a swap of two list entries: yes [fast a:9/9 runs differ (b:0), safe a:9/9 runs differ (b:0), ]

benchmarks.notes: fast = default library, safe = MathModeSafe; band = relative margin 1.0e-4 (margin / (|dist| + radius + 1) for planes, / (|len - r| + maxDistance) for distance, / (diam + minPixels) for screen size); ComputeTimer laps: one dispatch each, Dispatch->Dispatch barrier between. (b') decoupled look-back not implemented: no forward-progress guarantee between threadgroups on Apple GPUs. Camera::getFrustumPlanes() slot 4 (row3+row2) is not the near plane of the reverse-Z projection (z <= +near, accepts points behind the camera): slot 5 (row3-row2) is; this spike uses row3-row2.
benchmarks.title: F5-S4: culling of 1M instances + stable compaction (scan) vs atomics
